proofs.text: With only `.purlin/plugin-root` pointing at this checkout, run the shim and verify exit 0 with `the tagged tests passed`; delete that file, set `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` instead and verify the same; delete it again and copy the plugin under `$HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/purlin/purlin/0.10.0/` and verify the same; with none of the four present verify exit 0 with `the plugin was not found` and `PURLIN_PLUGIN_ROOT` in the output; write `/no/such/plugin` into `.purlin/plugin-root` with `PURLIN_PLUGIN_ROOT` at this checkout and verify the checkout wins

rule_text: The shim takes the first plugin root that carries `scripts/hooks/pre-push.sh` out of `PURLIN_PLUGIN_ROOT`, `.purlin/plugin-root`, `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and a marketplace copy under the home directory, in that order, and warns and exits 0 when none of them does

tests.body:
def test_a_marketplace_copy_under_home_is_found(self, passing):
        installed = os.path.join(passing.home, '.claude', 'plugins', 'cache',
                                 'purlin', 'purlin', '0.10.0')
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(installed), exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copytree(ROOT, installed,
                        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('.git', 'design',
                                                      'docs', '__pycache__'))
        os.remove(passing.path('.purlin/plugin-root'))
        done = passing.push(plugin_root=None)
        assert done.returncode == 0, done.stdout + done.stderr
        assert 'the tagged tests passed' in done.stdout
tests.name: test_a_marketplace_copy_under_home_is_found

def test_an_environment_root_wins_over_the_pinned_one(self, passing):
        write(passing.path('.purlin/plugin-root'), '/no/such/plugin\n')
        done = passing.push()
        assert done.returncode == 0, done.stdout + done.stderr
        assert 'the tagged tests passed' in done.stdout
tests.name: test_an_environment_root_wins_over_the_pinned_one

def test_claude_plugin_root_is_enough(self, passing):
        os.remove(passing.path('.purlin/plugin-root'))
        done = passing.push(plugin_root=None,
                            env={'CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT': ROOT})
        assert done.returncode == 0, done.stdout + done.stderr
        assert 'the tagged tests passed' in done.stdout
tests.name: test_claude_plugin_root_is_enough

def test_no_plugin_anywhere_warns_and_never_blocks(self, passing):
        os.remove(passing.path('.purlin/plugin-root'))
        done = passing.push(plugin_root=None)
        assert done.returncode == 0, done.stdout + done.stderr
        assert 'the plugin was not found' in done.stdout
        assert 'PURLIN_PLUGIN_ROOT' in done.stdout
tests.name: test_no_plugin_anywhere_warns_and_never_blocks

def test_the_pinned_plugin_root_is_enough(self, passing):
        done = passing.push(plugin_root=None)
        assert done.returncode == 0, done.stdout + done.stderr
        assert 'the tagged tests passed' in done.stdout
        assert read(passing.path('.purlin/plugin-root')).strip() == ROOT
tests.name: test_the_pinned_plugin_root_is_enough
